General.Title: General
General.Subtitle: Applies to every campaign.
General.AddressHint: Where every campaign sends its events.
General.ChatHint: New, edited and deleted messages, and the log being cleared.
General.Results: Hit/miss and save results in the app
General.ResultsHint: Follow: hits, misses and saves show where Foundry shows players them, by dnd5e's Attack Result Visibility and Challenge Visibility and Midi-QOL's Auto Check Hits and Auto Check Saves. Always: players see every target's hit or miss, and every save and check's success or failure. Armor class and DCs still need GM-only details, and whispers and blind rolls still go only to those who may read them.
General.CombatHint: Encounters, turns, rounds, initiative and defeats.
General.GmContentHint: Whispers, blind rolls, hidden combatants, other creatures' hit points, targets' armor class, and every hit, miss and save. Keep off if players can see what the app receives.
General.MidiIntegrationHint: Midi checks hits, rolls saves and applies damage and effects, as you have it set up. Off: attacks, spells and features stay in the app.
General.OffCanvasHint: Midi automates only tokens your screen shows; apply the rest from the card. Off: such uses are refused.

Players.EmptyHint: Only the characters you add appear here.

Actions.RollsHint: Checks, saves, initiative, death saves and hit dice use the dice they roll there.
Actions.AttacksHint: Made here at the targets they pick, spending slots, uses and ammunition, with their dice.
Actions.PromptsHint: Saves Foundry would wait on a player to roll are asked in the app instead. With Midi-QOL checking saves, its saves, concentration and turn saves are asked in the app too, while the character is open there.

Actions.DicePlayers: Allow Players to enter dice results manually
Actions.DicePlayersHint: They type in what their own dice show, once each turns it on in the app's settings. A character's player needs Make Manual Rolls, which Manual Dice's roles set.
Actions.DiceNeedsRolls: Needs Players roll in the app.

ManualDice.active: Manual Dice is on. Players with Make Manual Rolls may enter their dice results in the app.
ManualDice.off: Manual Dice is installed but off: enable it in its settings.
ManualDice.inactive: Manual Dice is installed but not enabled in this world.

Actions.TransfersHint: From the app, they take from and give to the campaign's parties they own in Foundry, and give to each other's characters. You can move anything between its characters and parties. Each move posts a line in chat.

Error.Network: the app could not be reached
Error.Timeout: the app did not answer in time
Error.TooLarge: the event came to {size}, more than the {limit} the app takes

Notify.Reconnected: Sending Stone reaches the app again.
Notify.CampaignRecovered: Sending Stone delivers {campaign}'s events to the app again.
Notify.RollsStopped: Sending Stone has stopped fetching {campaign}'s players' rolls: {problem} {fix} Saving Sending Stone's settings tries again.
Notify.RollsFailing: {campaign}'s players' rolls aren't reaching the game: {problem} Still trying.
Notify.RollsRecovered: {campaign}'s players' rolls reach the game again.
Notify.SheetTooLarge: Sending Stone can't send {name}'s sheet to {campaign}: it came to {size}, more than the {limit} the app takes. Its player is told.
Notify.SheetTooLargeUntold: Sending Stone can't send {name}'s sheet to {campaign}: it came to {size}, more than the {limit} the app takes.
Notify.JournalTooLarge: {name} came to {size}, more than {campaign} takes, so its notes aren’t sent. Players see them as they were.

Problem.unreachable: Sending Stone can't reach the app at {address}.
Problem.offline: This computer is offline, so Sending Stone can't reach the app.
Problem.timeout: The app at {address} didn't answer in time.
Problem.unavailable: The app at {address} had a problem of its own (HTTP {status}).
Problem.rateLimited: The app at {address} asked Sending Stone to slow down (HTTP {status}).
Problem.notForge: The app takes games hosted on The Forge only, and this game's address, {origin}, isn't one.
Problem.unsupportedProtocol: The app doesn't read what this version of Sending Stone sends{detail}.
Problem.badEnvelope: The app couldn't read what Sending Stone sent{detail}.
Problem.noSecret: This browser has no secret for {campaign}.
Problem.notSetUp: The app has no campaign titled “{campaign}” for this game, {origin}.
Problem.tooLarge: {what} for {campaign} came to {size}, more than the {limit} the app takes, and wasn't sent.
Problem.malformed: The app couldn't read {what} for {campaign}{detail}, and dropped it.

Fix.unreachable: Check the address in Sending Stone's settings (Test says more) and that the app is up. Events are lost until it answers; characters are sent again once it does.
Fix.timeout: Check the address in Sending Stone's settings (Test says more) and that the app is up. Events are lost until it answers; characters are sent again once it does.
Fix.unavailable: Each post is tried three times; if this lasts, the app may be down.
Fix.rateLimited: Each post is tried three times; if this lasts, the app may be down.
Fix.notForge: Open the game from its Forge address, such as https://your-game.forge-vtt.com, and set the campaign up in the app with it.
Fix.badEnvelope: Update the Sending Stone module; if it keeps happening, report it with the browser console's log.
Fix.noSecret: Enter its secret in Sending Stone's settings here: secrets are kept only in the browser they're entered in.
Fix.wrongSecret: Enter the secret set for {campaign} in the Sending Stone app, then Test.
Fix.notSetUp: Set it up in the Sending Stone app with this title and this game's Forge address, or rename it here to match the app's, then Test.
Fix.malformed: This is a bug in Sending Stone: please report it, with the module's version. Nothing else is held back.
Fix.status: Check the address in Sending Stone's settings.

Status.Withheld: {name}'s sheet is withheld: it came to {size}, more than the {limit} the app takes.
Status.OtherBrowser: Events go from {name}'s browser, the active Gamemaster's, which is told of any problem.

Test.Ok: Delivered: the app answered HTTP {status} in {elapsed} ms.
Test.HintNetwork: Check that the address is right and the app is reachable from this computer, and that it answers the browser's CORS preflight (OPTIONS) request with Access-Control-Allow-Origin, and Access-Control-Allow-Headers covering Content-Type and Authorization.
Test.HintMixedContent: Foundry is served over https but the app's address is plain http, which browsers block for any host other than localhost. Use the app's https address.
Test.Unsaved: Save Changes for events to use what you typed.
